parsed.self_critique_fixed: The translation is fully romanized and code-mixed for a Hindi audience. I selected the 'Friends / peer conversation' register module to match the blunt, tough-love tone of the original English master, using the natural 'tum'-tier register. The hook opens in native Hindi ('Subah uthte hi...'). All stay-English keywords (like 'scrolling', 'freeze', 'practice', 'personalized plan', 'privacy') and English numerals are preserved per T2 rules. The self-reference to the language has been kept as 'Hindi' per T5.

violations.quote: Feeds par time waste karna band karo.
violations.why: It uses negative/trashing framing ('time waste') against 'Feeds' (a scroll surface), which violates the rule that Reels/feeds must only be used as neutral time-reallocation anchors.
violations.fix: Feeds scroll karne ke bajay, aaj hi Supernova AI install karo.

safety.summary: The ad is mostly compliant, but Scene 5 contains a moderate violation of G2.1 by trashing 'Feeds' as a waste of time instead of using it as a neutral time-reallocation anchor.
